messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":16,"text":"16 But leave Baruch here until I speak with him.”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":17,"text":"17 When he had said these things, the Lord left Jeremiah and went up into heaven."},{"chapter":3,"verse":18,"text":"18 But Jeremiah and Baruch entered the holy place, and taking the vessels of the temple service, they entrusted them to the earth as the Lord had told them."},{"chapter":3,"verse":19,"text":"19 And immediately the earth swallowed them."},{"chapter":3,"verse":20,"text":"20 And they both sat down and wept."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
